rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded blastocyst with thinning zona, compact ICM, and cohesive TE consistent with the reported 3AA grade; appropriately notes limits of a single static image. Slight hedge on TE being A or possibly B prevents a perfect score.
Strongly integrates maternal age, PCOS, ovarian response, endometrial thickness, semen parameters, BMI, lifestyle, and first-cycle status with embryo morphology and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, especially emphasizing age-related aneuploidy as the main limiter despite excellent morphology. Minor overreach in discussing fresh-transfer hormonal environment without supporting hormone data.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading interpretation and standard IVF practice, including SET, luteal support, and consideration of PGT-A/cavity assessment. Slightly speculative elements keep it from full marks.

Provides clear practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including monitoring, transfer technique, luteal support, uterine evaluation, and metabolic/endocrine workup.
